description.zh:
数据结束时间戳（单位：秒），如：1684166400 
不填默认为当前时间
description.en: The end timestamp of the data, in seconds. Example: 1684166400. If this parameter is not specified, the current time is used by default.

description.zh:
可选项

- 0：任务类基础信息
- 1：任务运行信息
description.en:
The metric type. Valid values:

- 0: basic task information.
- 1: task execution information.

description.zh: 命名空间来源，特殊第三方才需要填写
description.en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for special third-party integrations.

description.zh:
可选项

- query：查询区间数据
- query_range：查询区间时许数据
description.en:
The operation type. Valid values:

- query: queries interval data.
- query_range: queries interval time series data.

description.zh: 数据起始时间戳（单位：秒），如：1684166400
description.en: The start timestamp of the data, in seconds. Example: 1684166400.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 get-overview --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --operate query --metric-type 0 --start-time 1684166400 --end-time 1684166400 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun schedulerx2 GetOverview --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime 1684166400 --MetricType 0 --NamespaceSource schedulerx --StartTime 1684166400 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Operate query --Namespace 'adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000' --GroupId 'testSchedulerx.defaultGroup'
